notes.title: 6.6 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Removed audio ping from attachment center.
[*] Moved attachment center to left side of in-game Menu in the Home scene.
[*] Accuracy increased from 59 - 65 threshold for a good accuracy status.
[*] Removed a debug cube from scenes.
[*] Fixed gun models being incorrect size after being grabbed or placed in a snap zone.
[*] Scaled down the Silencer for Pistol from 1.0 - 0.8
[*] Added Gridshot to back wall of Home scene.
[*] Added peaking targets on the sidewalk behind the fence in the Home scene.
[*] Bad Accuracy will be displayed if TTK was good otherwise it will display as both being bad with more accurate Reccomendations.
[*] Check mark added to task timer length to indicate which option is selected.
[*] Slider UI selected color in settings has been darkened.
[*] Adjusted Valve Index Controllers rotation to be slightly downwards pitched and slightly angled towards the right for a more natural holding position.
[/list]
